hooks.command: if git submodule status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^-'; then git submodule update --init --recursive >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"systemMessage":"Initialized git submodules (dev/foundation)."}' || echo '{"systemMessage":"Submodule init FAILED — run: git submodule update --init --recursive"}'; fi

if [ "$(git config core.hooksPath 2>/dev/null)" != 'dev/tools/githooks' ]; then git config core.hooksPath dev/tools/githooks >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"systemMessage":"Installed the commit-msg hook (core.hooksPath -> dev/tools/githooks)."}' || echo '{"systemMessage":"commit-msg hook NOT installed — run: git config core.hooksPath dev/tools/githooks"}'; fi
